title: ascolepis eriocauloides

It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
